_note: ADR-131 visual identity restoration. EVERY screen is expected to differ, because the changes are theme-wide by design: Classic swaps the whole icon language from masked SVG back to emoji, Playful gains its own elevation ramp / halo / radius step, and both gain a re-tuned icon baseline. Screens are listed individually so a screen that DOES NOT change would still be noticed. The base and cand shoots also both include the harness fixes (premium seeding + zero-duration animations), so the playful shots are genuinely playful for the first time. The matrix now shoots FOUR combinations: playful DARK was previously never captured, which is exactly where the last inherited-elevation defect was hiding.
